regions.name: rio Javarí
regions.quote: The majority of records pertain to the rio Javarí, an Amazonian tributary which forms the border between Brazil and Peru for much of its length and empties into the Amazon main channel in the Três Fronteiras area, where the borders of Brazil, Peru and Colombia meet.
